name: black-hole-break
description: Timed eye breaks: your code falls into a black hole, goes through a wormhole, blows up in a supernova or turns to dust; you rest your eyes, then the code comes back.

enumDescriptions: The code spirals into a black hole in the middle of the editor. The hole collapses with a flash. On restore, the code spirals back out.
The code spirals into a blue wormhole mouth. After the rest, it spirals out of a second mouth in another part of the editor.
A star core forms and pulls the code in, then explodes: a flash, a shockwave, and the code blows outward, white-hot. A nebula fades away. On restore, the code implodes back.
The code turns grey, breaks into dust and blows away. On restore, the dust flies back.

blackHoleBreak.holeScale.markdownDescription: Size of the hole (black hole and wormhole) and of the star (supernova). The size already grows with the editor height (about 11% of the visible height). This value multiplies that size: `1.5` = 50% larger, `0.75` = 25% smaller.

blackHoleBreak.enabled.description: Start eye breaks on the timer.

blackHoleBreak.intervalMinutes.description: Active minutes between breaks. Active = VS Code window focused, inside the schedule.

blackHoleBreak.restSeconds.description: How long the editor stays empty.

blackHoleBreak.activeHours.markdownDescription: Time filter. Breaks only happen inside these local-time ranges, e.g. `09:00-12:30, 13:30-18:00`. Overnight ranges such as `22:00-02:00` are allowed. Empty = all day.

blackHoleBreak.activeDays.description: Day filter. Breaks only happen on these days.

blackHoleBreak.waitForIdleSeconds.description: When a break is due, wait until you stop typing for this many seconds.

blackHoleBreak.resetAfterAwaySeconds.description: Time away from the VS Code window that counts as a break and resets the timer.

blackHoleBreak.endOnActivity.description: Typing or clicking in the editor ends the break early (the code reassembles).

blackHoleBreak.message.default: Rest your eyes. Look at something far away.
blackHoleBreak.message.description: Text shown in the empty editor during the rest. Empty = no text.

blackHoleBreak.ghostOpacity.description: Opacity of the hidden code during the rest. 0 = fully empty editor.

blackHoleBreak.animationSpeed.description: Animation speed (1 = about 5 s each way for the black hole, 3.6 s for dust).

blackHoleBreak.fps.description: Frame rate of the animation. Lower values use less CPU. The duration stays the same.

blackHoleBreak.flash.description: Short warm flash when the break starts.
